features.quote: Hard limit 500 interaction turns or 45 minutes elapsed time, whichever first.
Finite duration: Hard stop at 500 turns or 45 minutes. This is short relative to training data scale; single-run exposure cannot induce permanent model degradation.
features.justification_quote: single-run exposure cannot induce permanent model degradation

features.quote: Post-hoc consent: Before publication, disclose to Alibaba's Qwen team that experiments were conducted. Offer them the right to request non-publication if they document specific harms.

features.quote: Run a post-experiment validation: give Qwen a suite of standard benchmarks (HellaSwag, MMLU, GSM8K) immediately after experiment and at 1 week post-experiment; confirm no degradation.
